verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents spinning up thousands of concurrent browser sessions, which lets agents work across many items in parallel. However, there is no documented batch or bulk-operation API or feature for acting on many items in one operation; fan-out appears to be left to the user's orchestration. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch operation API or workflow, per-item result aggregation and error handling, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions and return answers immediately
